title.en: Ooredoo Commits $800M Stake in $1GW Zankore AI Infrastructure Project
title.zhHans: Ooredoo 承诺 8 亿美元持股 Zankore 1GW AI 智算基础设施项目

searchSummary.en: Ooredoo Group committed $800 million for a 49% founding stake in Zankore, targeting 1 GW total NVIDIA AI compute capacity across Southeast Asia.
searchSummary.zhHans: Ooredoo 集团出资 8 亿美元持股 49% 成立 Zankore，旨在东南亚建设 1 GW NVIDIA AI 智算总容量。

summary.en: On August 6, 2026, Ooredoo Group announced a 49% founding stake and $800 million commitment in Zankore, a joint venture aiming to deploy 1 GW of NVIDIA AI compute infrastructure across Indonesia and Southeast Asia.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 6 日，Ooredoo 集团宣布出资 8 亿美元持有 Zankore 49% 创办股权。该合资公司计划在印尼及东南亚建设 1 GW NVIDIA AI 智算基础设施。

narrative.en: Qatari telecommunications operator Ooredoo Group announced an approximately $800 million investment to secure a 49% founding stake in Zankore, a multi-party AI compute initiative alongside Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, Nokia, and NVIDIA. The project aims to build an Indonesia-first AI cloud platform targeting 1 gigawatt of total NVIDIA DSX capacity, with an initial 200 megawatt phase scheduled for operational rollout in the first half of 2027.
narrative.zhHans: 卡塔尔电信运营商 Ooredoo 集团宣布投资约 8 亿美元，取得 Zankore 公司 49% 的创办股权。该项目由 Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison、诺基亚及 NVIDIA 联合发起，旨在建立首个针对印尼与东南亚的 AI 云平台，远期规划 1 吉瓦 NVIDIA DSX 智算容量，首期 200 兆瓦预计于 2027 年上半年投入运营。

description.en: Multi-hundred-million-dollar commitment to build gigawatt-scale AI compute infrastructure in Southeast Asia.
description.zhHans: 几亿美元级别的承诺，旨在东南亚建设吉瓦级 AI 智算基础设施。

text.en: On August 6, 2026, Ooredoo Group announced an $800 million commitment for a 49% founding stake in Zankore to target 1 GW total NVIDIA AI compute capacity in Southeast Asia.
text.zhHans: 2026年8月6日，Ooredoo 集团宣布出资 8 亿美元持股 49% 成立 Zankore，旨在在东南亚建设 1 GW NVIDIA AI 智算总容量。

text.en: Represents one of the largest telecom-backed sovereign compute commitments in Southeast Asia.
text.zhHans: 代表了东南亚地区由电信巨头支持的规模最大的主权 AI 智算基础设施投资承诺之一。

text.en: The investment represents a multi-year project target with initial 200 MW capacity planned for H1 2027 rather than currently active server capacity.
text.zhHans: 该投资代表多年期基础设施规划，首期 200 MW 算力计划于 2027 年上半年上线，而非目前已在运行的算力。

editorial.reviewNotes: Draft created after confirmation sweep. Fact boundary: investment commitment and multi-year infrastructure roadmap.
